rationale: Final 4 h of batch culture. Consumed remaining fermentable carbohydrates (maltose, arabinose) and amino acids (leucine, glutamine, aspartate) to support modest growth. Fermentation produces acetate, butyrate, formate, H₂, and CO₂. Carbon balance audited: ~23 mmol C in supports ~2.3 mmol C biosynthesis + ~20.7 mmol C fermentation products. Nitrogen from glutamine and aspartate covers biosynthetic demand (~0.6 mmol N/gDW/h).
